cc:Work.dc:description:
A hook with a rectangular mouth to mount at the wall
Created with Boxes.py (https://boxes.hackerspace-bamberg.de/) Command line: boxes Hook --width 60 --height 30 --depth 50 --strength 25 --angle 85 --thickness 4 --reference 0 --labels 0 Command line short: boxes Hook --width --height --depth --strength --angle --thickness --reference --labels
